cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(fx C)
enable_testing()
add_executable(t_pass pass.c)
add_executable(t_fail fail.c)
add_executable(t_skip skip.c)
add_executable(t_sleep sleep.c)
add_executable(t_abort abort.c)
add_executable(t_segv segv.c)
add_executable(t_notbuilt notbuilt.c)
set_target_properties(t_notbuilt PROPERTIES EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL TRUE)
add_test(NAME pass COMMAND t_pass)
add_test(NAME fail COMMAND t_fail)
add_test(NAME skip COMMAND t_skip)
set_tests_properties(skip PROPERTIES SKIP_RETURN_CODE 77)
add_test(NAME timeout COMMAND t_sleep)
set_tests_properties(timeout PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 1)
add_test(NAME abort COMMAND t_abort)
add_test(NAME segv COMMAND t_segv)
add_test(NAME notrun COMMAND ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/t_notbuilt)
add_test(NAME notrun_disabled COMMAND t_pass)
set_tests_properties(notrun_disabled PROPERTIES DISABLED TRUE)
add_test(NAME regex_fail COMMAND t_pass)
set_tests_properties(regex_fail PROPERTIES PASS_REGULAR_EXPRESSION "never printed")
add_test(NAME will_fail COMMAND t_fail)
set_tests_properties(will_fail PROPERTIES WILL_FAIL TRUE)
add_executable(t_sig sig.c)
add_test(NAME kill9 COMMAND t_sig 9)
add_test(NAME fpe COMMAND t_sig 8)
add_test(NAME ill COMMAND t_sig 4)
add_test(NAME term COMMAND t_sig 15)
add_test(NAME skip_regex COMMAND t_pass)
set_tests_properties(skip_regex PROPERTIES SKIP_REGULAR_EXPRESSION "ok")
add_test(NAME exit77_noskip COMMAND t_skip)
add_test(NAME fail_regex COMMAND t_pass)
set_tests_properties(fail_regex PROPERTIES FAIL_REGULAR_EXPRESSION "ok")
